purpose: Select exactly one economically interpretable Campaign117 mechanism from a finite catalog using only frozen definition metadata and accepted local source schema, before reading any Campaign117 source partition value, candidate value, comparator value, daily price, or forward return.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_weak_order_entropy_236t
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The complete library contains amount-mass entropy, magnitude serial persistence, clock moments, peaks, threshold runs and return-conditioned activity, but no full weak-order distribution of local amount triples. The statistic can be built from the accepted local amount field without a provider request and without reading a price or return.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_weak_order_time_reversal_divergence_236t
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Choosing between marginal weak-order complexity and time-arrow divergence would be an operator sweep. Campaign117 freezes normalized Shannon entropy only.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_transition_conditional_entropy
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: State-transition, Markov, lag and conditional-entropy choices introduce an open transition alphabet and lag search.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_volume_weak_order_entropy_236t
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Selecting between amount and share volume after values would be a field sweep; CNY amount is frozen as the activity state before values.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_transaction_price_weak_order_entropy_236t
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Transaction-price ordinal complexity belongs to the already dense price-path family and would require joint amount/volume active-bar semantics rather than the selected activity-only channel.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: terminal_factor_combination_or_model_retry
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Refitting, subsetting, rescuing or recombining exposed terminal results is not a genuinely new information mechanism.

selection.next_stage: Complete a semantic overlap audit and freeze one exact formula, support rule, source projection, ordered no-return gates, one-trial development protocol, costs and prohibitions before values.
